content: Potipa Lagona Yosepa I Hebabale

He boda Isimel Yosepa hi ahe hi pwatanik panuwa Itipita, yaka Potipa i pwamola wana totuwalali loloyowanina. Potipa iya Itipita wali kin wana totuwalali bwabwatana etega, wana limi ana tomatahikan wali tohouwa.
Yehoba i minaa Yosepa elana, inoke i labe ge bugul gegewena i ginolil hi waisi. He i miminaa wana tonowak Itipita gamagalina wana limiya.
Wana tonowak i kite Yehoba i minaa elana ge i labe bugul gegewena i ginolil hi waisi,
inoke i yaliyaya Yosepa kaiwena ge i teli ni totuwalali ya te iya eliyana. Yaka i ba wana limi ana totuwalali i houwaagil ge wana bugubugul gegewena i teli nimanaa i matahikagil.
Sauga o elana ge i nok, Yosepa kaiwena Yehoba Potipa wana limi ana heniheni i muloluagil waisi hi pwawa. Wana bugubugul gegewel, wana limi gamwanaa ge wana eyowaa, Yehoba i muloluagil hi waisi.
Inoke wana bugubugul gegewena ali logugui i pek Yosepa elana ni matahikagil, yaka iya nige i nuwanuwatu bugul etega kaiwena iyai te aanan toto i aan. He Yosepa i hebubun ge ana awa i waisi.
Wana minamina nige ana sauga i yayapu inoke wana tonowak lagona Yosepa i hebabale ge i baek elana i ba, “U nem alou owa ta kenu.”
Yaa Yosepa i towa, inoke i baek elana i ba, “No tonowak nige i nuwanuwatu bugul etega kaiwena wana limi gamwanaa, kaiwena nau ya minaa te. He wana bugubugul gegewena i teli nimwawa ya matahikagil.
No logugui i gan limi ya gamwanaa i ola iya, ge nige bugul etega i kakaise eliyau iyai te owa lagona. Inoke ga i ola ge pagan nanakina ya na ginol ge na gegi Yabowaine elana?”
Bwagana lan maisena ge maisena yova i mimi papalawakik Yosepa elana, yaa Yosepa i towa nige alona hi kekenu ge nige alona hi minamina.
Lan etegana Yosepa i na i tuk limiya tage ni tuwalali, he sauga o elana nige limi ana totuwalali etegana i miminaa to.
Yaka Potipa lagona i na Yosepa ana holahola i kukuhikan, inoke i baek elana i ba, “U nem alou owa ta kenu!” Yaa Yosepa ana holahola i lou luwana yova nimanaa ge i lou tagil noleleya.
Sauga yova i kite Yosepa ana holahola i lou luwana nimanaa ge i lou tagil noleleya,

inoke wana limi ana totuwalali i yogaagil hi nem, ge i baek elal i ba, “Ku kite i! Hibilu gamagalina toto ya no tonowak i pwatanim eliyala, i papapuluwawi-agila. I nem i ulutuk no lum gamwanaa nuwana alou naha kenu, inoke ya yoga nabi.
Sauga anau i hago, yaka ana holahola i lou luwana labewa ge i lou tagil noleleya.”
He yova Yosepa ana holahola i teliya labenaa ana siga lagona i sikalim limiya.
Inoke wasa maisena i wasaan al lagona elana i ba, “Totuwalali loloyowanina Hibilu gamagalina toto u pwatanim eliyala, i nem i ulutuk no lum gamwanaa tage ni papuluwawi-agau.
Yaa sauga ya yoga, inoke ana holahola i lou luwana labewa ge i lou tagil noleleya.”
Yosepa wana tonowak lagona wana baaba i hago, inoke i huga nabi,
yaka i ba tolohaveyan Yosepa hi lib hi na hi teli dela, del toto kin wana tololoyowan wali abamina. He sauga Yosepa iyoho dela,
Yehoba i minaa elana yaka i nunuwana-an ge i muloluan, inoke del ana tomatahikan i yaliyaya iya kaiwena.
Yaka i teli todibula gegewel i houwaagil ge del ana tuwalali gegewena i matahikan.
He del ana tomatahikan nige i nuwanuwatu tuwalali toto Yosepa i matahikan kaiwena, kaiwena Yehoba i minaa Yosepa elana, inoke i labe ge bugul gegewena i ginolil hi waisi.
